title: Preference Tuning ProGen2 (DPO and Bradley-Terry) vs Claude Mythos 5.2 and ESMC Ridge on FLIP2
models_tested: Claude Mythos 5.2 (reference from FLIP2 ICL experiment)
plm_baselines: ProGen2-small (151M) zero-shot, hidden-state ridge, DPO, Bradley-Terry, LoRA, slow LR, klarge, and DPO + NLL likelihood term (weights 0.01, 0.1, 1.0)
ProGen2-base (764M) zero-shot, hidden-state ridge, DPO (fixed 20 epochs)
code_and_data_released: Full code, Docker entrypoint, pinned Hub checkpoints, tuning logs, and tables publicly released.

methods.datasets: Identical 16 FLIP2 splits and 2 post-cutoff FGFR2 splits from our_2026_flip2_in_context (k=256 training rows, 205 train / 51 held-out validation; plus klarge up to 2,048 rows).
methods.evaluation_protocol: Pre-specified recipe tunes all weights of ProGen2-small with Plackett-Luce ranked DPO (lr in {1e-5, 1e-4}, beta in {0.1, 2}, up to 20 epochs) or Bradley-Terry loss, selecting checkpoint on 51 held-out rows. Follow-up diagnostic tests fixed recipe (lr=1e-5, beta=2, 20 epochs, no validation selection) evaluated cleanly on held-out queries 101-300 for ProGen2-small and ProGen2-base.
methods.controls_included: Shuffled-label DPO control (drops -0.109 below untuned), 3 batch-order seeds, untuned zero-shot likelihood, hidden-state ridge, in-distribution 51-row evaluation of all baselines, and untouched queries 101-300 for fixed-recipe verification.
methods.compute_and_tools: Ran in Docker on oracle_gh200; bidirectional float32 mean log-likelihood verified against Salesforce's reference sanity cross-entropy (2.4 small, 1.9 base).
methods.metrics: Mean Spearman correlation with 95% paired bootstrap intervals (2,000 draws).

key_results.baseline_model: ProGen2-small DPO (pre-specified val-selected) / ProGen2-base DPO (fixed 20 ep)
key_results.notes: Pre-specified ProGen2-small DPO loses by 0.117 because i.i.d. validation selection hurts under FLIP2 distribution shift; fixed 20-epoch ProGen2-base reaches 0.360 (tie) on FLIP2 and still trails Mythos on post-cutoff FGFR2 (0.379 vs 0.561, -0.183).
Evaluated on queries 101-300 that had no role in selecting the fixed recipe; tuned ProGen2 ties but never surpasses ESMC ridge.

key_results.benchmark: FLIP2 untouched queries 101-300 & first 100 (16 splits, k=256)
key_results.llm_model: Best ESMC ridge (0.351 on q101-300) / Claude Mythos 5.2 (0.380 on q1-100)
key_results.baseline_model: ProGen2-small fixed 20ep + preferred-row NLL term (weights 1.0 primary, 0.1, 0.01)
key_results.notes: Without an NLL anchor, DPO collapses query log-likelihood by 5.6 nats/residue (-7.71 vs -2.12 released). Adding preferred-row NLL (Pang et al. / ProGen3 loss) stops the collapse (-1.46 at w=0.1) and adds ~0.02 at light weights (0.348 vs 0.324), reaching a tie with ESMC ridge and Mythos 5.2 without beating either.

temporal_cutoff.evidence: Includes post-cutoff FGFR2 splits where ProGen2-base fixed DPO (0.379) trails both Mythos 5.2 (0.561) and ESMC ridge (0.572).

homology_overlap.evidence: Explicitly isolates distribution shift by scoring all baselines on both the 51 i.i.d. held-out rows (ESMC-600M ridge 0.637 vs ProGen2-small 0.522) and shifted FLIP2 test queries.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: ProGen2 is a sequence-only pLM; Mythos 5.2 reference comes from our controlled FLIP2/FGFR2 experiment.

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Explicitly avoids test-set selection bias by validating the post-hoc fixed recipe on untouched queries 101-300 and flagging first-100 scores as optimistic.

downstream_oracle_filtering.evidence: Direct variant ranking without candidate filtering.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: Same 256 labeled training rows; full weight tuning on GPU compared honestly against zero-weight-update ESMC ridge and Mythos ICL.

baseline_fairness.evidence: Tests full-weight DPO, Bradley-Terry, hidden-state ridge, LoRA, 10x lower LR, klarge up to 2,048 rows, and ProGen2-base; transparently notes ESMC fine-tuning remains untested.

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: All checkpoints pinned by SHA, sanity cross-entropy checked, all code and tables public.

takeaway: Preference tuning ProGen2 on the same 256 FLIP2 rows trails Claude Mythos 5.2 and ESMC ridge under pre-specified held-out checkpoint selection (0.263 vs 0.380 / 0.367) and reaches a tie without passing either under a fixed 20-epoch ProGen2-base recipe (0.360 on FLIP2; 0.339 vs 0.351 ridge on untouched queries 101-300) or ProGen2-small + light NLL anchor (w=0.1: 0.348 on q101-300, 0.378 on q1-100, fixing the 5.6-nat likelihood collapse), while trailing both on post-cutoff FGFR2.
